description: TimescaleDB equivalent of the InfluxDB JMeter dashboard by Rob Leijenaar

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  scenario_name AS "scenario",
  transaction_name AS "transaction",
  ROUND(sum(avg_rt * n) / NULLIF(sum(n), 0)) AS "AvgAll",
  ROUND(sum(sum_rt_ok)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(n_ok), 0)) AS "AvgOk",
  sum(n) AS "# Samples",
  ROUND(approx_percentile(0.90, rollup(pct_agg))::numeric) AS "90%",
  ROUND(approx_percentile(0.95, rollup(pct_agg))::numeric) AS "95%",
  ROUND(approx_percentile(0.99, rollup(pct_agg))::numeric) AS "99%",
  min(min_rt) AS "Minimal",
  max(max_rt) AS "Maximal",
  ROUND(sum(n_err)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(n), 0) * 100.0, 2) AS "ErrorRate",
  sum(n_err) AS "Errors",
  ROUND(approx_percentile(0.50, rollup(pct_agg))::numeric) AS "Median",
  ROUND(stddev_samp(avg_rt), 2) AS "Stddev"
FROM transactions_${cagg_suffix}
WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' AND test_environment = '$test_environment' AND $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

SELECT
  scenario_name AS "scenario",
  transaction_name AS "transaction",
  sum(bytes_out) AS "Sent bytes",
  sum(bytes_in) AS "Received bytes"
FROM requests_raw_${cagg_suffix}
WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' AND test_environment = '$test_environment' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) AND transaction_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', bucket) AS time,
  sum(n) AS "Total transactions"
FROM transactions_${cagg_suffix}
WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' AND test_environment = '$test_environment' AND $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', bucket) AS time,
  sum(n_err) AS "Failed transactions"
FROM transactions_${cagg_suffix}
WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' AND test_environment = '$test_environment' AND $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', bucket) AS time,
  sum(n_ok)::float / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '$__interval'::INTERVAL) AS "Successful transactions",
  sum(n_err)::float / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '$__interval'::INTERVAL) AS "Failed transactions"
FROM transactions_${cagg_suffix}
WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' AND test_environment = '$test_environment' AND $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT

FROM requests_error_${cagg_suffix}

ORDER BY 1, 2;

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT
  SUM(max_at) AS "Threads"
FROM (
  SELECT scenario_name, node_name, MAX(active_threads) AS max_at
  FROM virtual_users
  WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' AND test_environment = '$test_environment' AND $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) sub;

SELECT
  time,
  scenario_name,
  SUM(max_at) AS "Active threads"
FROM (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time,

    node_name,

  WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' AND test_environment = '$test_environment' AND $__timeFilter(time)

SELECT
